cards.name: Extrude & Bevel (Classic)
cards.summary: Classic (pre-2022) 3D: pushes flat vector art back into a solid block of the set depth and rotates it in space, shading the sides with the object's own colours (sides are darker tints of the fill / stroke). The result stays vector faces, can carry a bevel profile on the edges and wrap symbols onto faces with Map Art.
use_for: isometric / extruded logo or headline with vector side faces
3D block lettering for signage or vinyl output after Expand Appearance
packaging mock-up box from a flat rectangle with Map Art labels
retro chunky 3D type
avoid: Scripting with chosen values: pageItem.applyEffect of 'Adobe 3D Effect' with only a few keys stores the effect but draws nothing; the gallery render drew only after the full dialog dictionary (rotation matrix mat_* included) was written in, saved and reopened, and even then only the plain-filled star extruded while the stroked rounded box, gradient circle, type and open zigzag stayed flat (and applying it to the group drew nothing). For dependable output use the menu command on each object, or the new 3D and Materials Extrude & Bevel.
Photoreal lighting, soft shadows or materials: use Effect/3D and Materials/Extrude & Bevel (the new 3D) instead.
Gradient fills: classic 3D shades gradients poorly and slowly; expand gradients or use the new 3D.

params.name: extrudeDepth
params.does: Extrude Depth in points: how deep the side walls go

params.name: extrudeCap
params.does: Cap on = solid object; off = hollow shell with open ends

params.name: bevelHeight
params.does: height of the bevel profile in points (only matters when a bevel is chosen in the dialog)

params.name: bevelExtentIn
params.does: true = bevel cut into the shape (Bevel Extent In); false = bevel added outside (Extent Out)

params.name: rotX
params.does: rotation around the X axis in degrees (tilts the top toward or away from you)

params.name: rotY
params.does: rotation around the Y axis in degrees (turns the object left / right)
params.typical: -26 default; -40 to -50 for a strong side view

params.name: rotZ
params.does: rotation around the Z axis in degrees (spins the object in the picture plane)

params.name: cameraPerspective
params.does: perspective angle in degrees: 0 = no perspective (parallel edges), higher = edges converge

params.name: surfaceStyle
params.does: surface shading code (the dialog offers Wireframe / No Shading / Diffuse / Plastic Shading; harvest default here is 3, code-to-label mapping not confirmed)

params.name: surfaceAmbient
params.does: Ambient Light %: brightness of faces turned away from the light

params.name: blendSteps
params.does: number of shading blend steps; higher = smoother shading but heavier art

params.name: numArtMaps
params.does: number of symbols mapped onto faces with Map Art (0 = none)

params.name: effectStyle
params.does: which classic 3D operation the shared 'Adobe 3D Effect' performs

cards.scripting: app.executeMenuCommand("Live 3DExtrude") with the art selected: opens the '3D Extrude & Bevel Options (Classic)' dialog, which reopens with the last-used values (Enter accepts them). The harvest found no scripted route that sets the values and draws: pageItem.applyEffect('<LiveEffect name="Adobe 3D Effect"><Dict data="I effectStyle 0 R extrudeDepth 120 R cameraPerspective 30"/></LiveEffect>') stores the effect but the harvest render check found it draws nothing (ai_live_effect was removed from invoke). Gallery render: applyEffect with the whole dictionary the dialog stores (mat_00..mat_33, rotX/rotY/rotZ, light0 ...) plus effectStyle 0 / extrudeDepth 120 / cameraPerspective 30, saved and reopened, did draw an extruded star (per object; on the group it drew nothing).
cards.cost: moderate: vector output, but high Blend Steps, Map Art and complex type make the file heavy and redraw slow

review.changes: scripting: 'values cannot be set from a script' softened to what the harvest showed; pairs_with: dropped 'Rotate (Classic)' (a second classic 3D effect on top is redundant)

verified.note: Applied per shape (on the group it drew nothing, index note), the blue star is pushed back into a solid with darker-blue side walls at the off-axis angle while the stroked box, gradient circle, type and zigzag stay flat, exactly as the card's summary and avoid line say.

previous.note: The blue star is pushed back into a solid with darker-blue side walls at the off-axis angle, matching the card; the stroked box, gradient circle, PGD type and zigzag stayed flat (only the star drew, per-object route).

cards.name: Revolve (Classic)
cards.summary: Classic (pre-2022) 3D: spins the selected art around a vertical axis at its edge to make a lathe-turned solid (bottle, vase, ring, cylinder); the usual input is a half-profile path. Output is shaded vector faces. By script it draws nothing: in the harvest probe on a filled+stroked rectangle neither the menu command (two Illustrator alerts answered with Enter) nor applyEffect changed the render, and the gallery's scripted apply on the test plate (revolveAngle 300) left the frame identical to the plate, so its look is not confirmed here; use its dialog by hand, or Effect > 3D and Materials > Revolve, which renders by script.
use_for: vector bottle, glass, vase or chess-piece from a half profile
rings and donuts from an offset profile
classic 3D product illustration that must expand to vector faces
avoid: Scripted builds: the harvest saw no visible change from either route on a closed rectangle, and the menu route raises Illustrator alert dialogs; use Effect/3D and Materials/Revolve, which rendered by script.
Feeding it a full closed shape: revolve a half profile (open path or half shape) or the result doubles back on itself.
Realistic lighting or materials: use the new Effect/3D and Materials/Revolve.

params.does: Cap on = solid ends; off = hollow surface

cards.name: Rotate (Classic)
cards.summary: Classic (pre-2022) 3D: turns flat art in 3D space without adding depth, so it looks like a card or sign seen at an angle (parallelogram, or a converging trapezoid with perspective); optional flat shading. Output stays vector.
use_for: tilting a flat label, screen or poster into a perspective mock-up
isometric-style faces for infographics
angled signboard or card in a vector scene
avoid: Scripting with chosen values: a plain applyEffect of 'Adobe 3D Effect' stores the effect but draws nothing, and on a whole group it drew nothing even through the gallery route; applied to each shape with the dialog's full dictionary written in (saved, reopened), the star, gradient circle, type and zigzag tilted while the stroked rounded box stayed flat. For dependable output use the menu command on each object, or the new 3D and Materials Rotate.
Needing depth or thickness: use Extrude & Bevel (Classic) or the new Extrude & Bevel.
Exact perspective against a drawn scene: the Perspective Grid gives control over vanishing points.

params.does: perspective angle in degrees: 0 = no perspective (parallel edges), higher = edges converge

params.does: surface shading code (harvest default 1 here; the Rotate dialog offers No Shading / Diffuse Shading, mapping not confirmed)

cards.name: Extrude & Bevel
cards.summary: The 3D and Materials panel's Extrude: gives flat art real depth and renders it as a lit 3D object (light direction, softness, ambient light, optional shadow, materials, ray-traced render). Sides pick up the art's colours (a stroked shape's walls take the stroke colour) and shade smoothly while front faces come out lighter; on a group the whole group turns as one rotated, extruded scene.
use_for: 3D logo or headline with realistic lighting
social-post 3D type and icons
product / packaging blocks with Substance materials
3D infographic bars and tiles
avoid: Print jobs that must stay clean, editable vector (vinyl cutting, screen print separations): by default Expand Appearance turns a 3D and Materials object into a raster image (the panel's Render as Vector setting gives non-editable vector only, and materials / ray tracing are raster); use Extrude & Bevel (Classic) or CorelDRAW Extrude for vector faces.
Large groups with lots of type: the 3D render (especially ray tracing) makes redraw slow; build the 3D on a simplified copy and expand when the design is final.
Bevel needed by script: the harvested dictionary carries no bevel keys (bevel was off at harvest), so a bevel has to be added in the panel.

Small type and thin open strokes at deep extrusion: in the gallery render (depth 150) 'PGD' and the zigzag became black slabs with barely readable fronts; keep depth shallow (30-60) for type or extrude it separately from the rest of the group.

Large groups with lots of type: the 3D render (especially ray tracing) makes redraw slow; build the 3D on a simplified copy and expand when the design is final.

cards.name: Materials
cards.summary: The 3D and Materials panel's Materials: applies a flat 3D plane (stored operation 4, the harvested 'Rotate / Materials' code, no rotation) so a surface material (Substance materials such as wood or marble, or the default material's Roughness / Metallic) and the panel's lighting can be put on flat art without giving it depth. On the test plate Metallic 100 / Roughness 15 with the sun at 100 % darkened every fill to a flat, deep tone (orange to dark brown, blue to navy, the yellow-to-magenta gradient to olive-brown) with no highlight, reflection or foil sheen; with default settings the harvest probe barely changed (mean abs pixel difference 1.272).
use_for: textured surface (wood, marble, fabric, paper Substance material) on flat badges and labels
lighting and material on already-3D art built with Extrude / Inflate / Revolve, where curved faces catch highlights
a deep, darkened tint of flat art without redrawing it (Metallic high)
avoid: Expecting gold foil or chrome from Metallic alone on a front-on plane: on the flat test plate Metallic 100 / Roughness 15 only darkened the fills (orange to dark brown, blue to navy) with no highlight; use a Substance material, tilt the art or apply the material to extruded / inflated art whose faces catch the light, and check the render.
Expecting a change with default settings: the default material on a front-on plane looks almost flat (harvest probe).
Choosing a Substance material by script: the material comes from a file path (MaterialFilePathKey) and the harvest only proved single-token strings in Dict data; paths with spaces are untested.

Print jobs that must stay clean, editable vector (vinyl cutting, screen print separations): by default Expand Appearance turns a 3D and Materials object into a raster image (the panel's Render as Vector setting gives non-editable vector only, and materials / ray tracing are raster); use Extrude & Bevel (Classic) or CorelDRAW Extrude for vector faces.
Large groups with lots of type: the 3D render (especially ray tracing) makes redraw slow; build the 3D on a simplified copy and expand when the design is final.

cards.name: Revolve

use_for: bottles, cans, cups and vases from a half profile
3D coins, discs and pucks
turned product mock-ups with materials

Revolving a whole wide layout: the solid's radius equals the art's width, so it balloons past the artboard; revolve a narrow half profile.

cards.summary: The 3D and Materials panel's Rotate: turns flat art in 3D space as a plane with no depth (stored operation 4, the harvested 'Rotate / Materials' code), lit by the panel's light; the probe rectangle became a flat parallelogram seen at an angle. Lighting and materials from the panel can be added.
use_for: tilting a flat label, screen or poster into an angled mock-up
angled cards and signs in a scene
flat art seen in space with a material or lighting
avoid: Print jobs that must stay clean, editable vector (vinyl cutting, screen print separations): by default Expand Appearance turns a 3D and Materials object into a raster image (the panel's Render as Vector setting gives non-editable vector only, and materials / ray tracing are raster); use Extrude & Bevel (Classic) or CorelDRAW Extrude for vector faces.
Large groups with lots of type: the 3D render (especially ray tracing) makes redraw slow; build the 3D on a simplified copy and expand when the design is final.
Needing thickness: use Effect/3D and Materials/Extrude & Bevel.

params.name: Geometry3DkRotationXKey
params.does: rotation around the X axis in RADIANS (tilt toward / away)

params.name: Geometry3DkRotationYKey
params.does: rotation around the Y axis in RADIANS (turn left / right)
params.typical: -0.45378561 default (= -26 deg); -0.6 to -0.8 for a strong side view

params.name: Geometry3DkRotationZKey
params.does: rotation around the Z axis in RADIANS (spin in the picture plane)

params.name: Geometry3DkFOVKey
params.does: perspective / field of view; 0 = no perspective (unit not confirmed by the harvest)

params.name: Geometry3DkSunlightIntensityKey
params.does: intensity of the main light (%)

params.name: Geometry3DkSunlightRotationKey
params.does: direction the main light comes from, in degrees around the object

params.name: Geometry3DkSunlightElevationKey
params.does: height of the main light above the object, in degrees
params.typical: 45 default; 20-30 for longer, more dramatic shading

params.name: Geometry3DkSunlightCloudinessKey
params.does: softness of the main light (stored as 'cloudiness'); higher = softer, wider highlights

params.name: Geometry3DkGlobalLightIntensityKey
params.does: ambient light intensity (%) that lifts the shadowed faces

params.name: MaterialRoughness
params.does: roughness of the default material: low = glossy, sharp highlights; high = matte
params.typical: 40 default; 10-20 for glossy plastic or metal

params.name: MaterialMetallic
params.does: how metallic the default material is: 0 = plastic / paint, high = metal reflecting its surroundings

params.name: Geometry3DkOperationTypeKey
params.does: which 3D operation the shared 'Adobe Geometry3D' effect performs

cards.scripting: pageItem.applyEffect('<LiveEffect name="Adobe Geometry3D"><Dict data="I Geometry3DkOperationTypeKey 4 R Geometry3DkRotationXKey -0.35 R Geometry3DkRotationYKey -0.79 R Geometry3DkRotationZKey 0"/></LiveEffect>') plus the other harvested keys at their defaults (the harvest round trip sent all 36); panel route: app.executeMenuCommand("Live Adobe Geometry3D Rotate").
cards.cost: moderate: flat plane, but still a 3D render

review.changes: vector-output avoid now notes Render as Vector instead of claiming expand is always raster; RotationZ default stated as -8.1 deg (-0.1413717 rad), not 'about -8'

verified.note: The whole group is turned as one flat plane in perspective with no depth (box a parallelogram, circle an ellipse, type and zigzag tilted) and lit lighter by the panel's light, as the card says.
